smart_document_chatbot.role: selective donor (read-only; MIT license, see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)

reuse_policy: No runtime dependency on project 1: no API calls, no package imports from its checkout, no shared database/collection.
Every copied file records source repo, commit, source path, destination path, reuse kind, sha256 of the donor file at copy time, and required modifications.
Ported-concept entries record the spec origin but contain no copied code.

entries.modifications: Remove tenant-filter fallback paths; BM25 corpus restricted to authorized scope; keep separate dense/bm25/fused score components.

truncate() counts TRUNCATE_SUFFIX inside the budget (donor returned max_chars + suffix); trim_messages() caps the leading system message (donor left it uncapped and blew the budget); inputs are never mutated; build_evidence_context() added for the evidence packet. Function names (trim_messages/cap_chunks/truncate) kept for traceability.

split_documents() is imported and called with version-scoped chunk IDs (doc_id_v{version}_{i}); no file copy, no fork. The missing llama-index dependency degrades to MAIA's own deterministic fallback splitter, so the Service Desk lock stays lean.
norm_tokens reuse for Vietnamese diacritic-insensitive BM25 matching; will add golden tests for accented/unaccented queries and error codes.
Replace legal article/clause metadata with title/section/version/page; retarget type imports and theme classes.
Map evidence states to runbook KB wording; theme tokens as needed.
Owner-only model replaced by tenant + requester + support-group model; no global-admin bypass.
Add available_at retry schedule, lease token fencing, unknown-outcome handling per S7; do not copy the implementation.
